messages:
jamie: FYI — search team saw intermittent 301s hitting the internal runtime guide. I traced it to two files that currently have the same canonical in frontmatter (runtime/guide.md and runtime/guide-v1.md). Quick snippet from the v1 file:
```---
canonical: /docs/runtime/guide
---```
Can someone owning the KB take a look? :eyes:

nora: thx for the heads-up. @jamie can you paste the repo paths (or grep output) so i can triage quickly?

jamie: paths are content/docs/runtime/guide.md and content/docs/runtime/guide-v1.md. quick rg I ran: `rg "canonical: /docs/runtime/guide" content/ -n` shows both files. the v1 is supposed to be a redirect stub but it still has the canonical.

sachin: I own runtime content — will take this. plan: remove the canonical from the redirect stub, ensure the redirect uses the canonical redirect table (not frontmatter), and open a PR. ETA today.

liz: @sachin i can run a staging build + linkcheck after your PR. also flag: the v1 file still lists KB-owner: old-team in frontmatter, so we should update owner metadata while we're in there.

docs-bot: Deploy preview created: https://deploy-preview-123--docs.internal/runtime/guide — linkcheck summary: 1 duplicate canonical found (content/docs/runtime/guide-v1.md).

nora: nice. @sachin if you want, mark this thread with :white_check_mark: when done and ping infra for a CDN cache purge + search re-crawl.

sachin: :thumbsup: opening PR now. will add a changelog line and update KB-owner to 'docs-runtime'.

jamie: perfect — thanks all. leaving a note in the runbook to verify the search index re-crawl after CDN purge. :white_check_mark:
